rv.q: Truly each actor felt perfectly cast and I would highly recommend catching this run while you can.

For anyone personally acquainted with (or at least comfortable around) Millennial and Gen-Z “femme fury”, Director Kayla Menz’s production of The Sporting Life is a riot that will have you laughing from beginning to end.
Unfortunately, this long, chaotic play devolves into one violent tableau after another—decapitations, disembowelments, and enough fake blood to mop the stage.

cn.t: This blood-soaked feminist satire about female rage and womanhood divides critics—younger audiences and those attuned to its themes find it darkly funny with stellar effects, while others see it as an appalling, excessive parody.
